items.text: glass and drum sounds added before they left the library are taken off the shelf
the cover is the name and the Founders Club; the field line lives in the Guide and the colophon
the FEME Starter, the Frost Electronic Music Ensemble's water pack, is back in the library and downloadable from the pack guide
the studio's glass and drums leave the public library again, and sounds and packs can't be saved or downloaded for now
the glass and drum sets are back in the library, now that Playing now says what is sounding
the Touch ring has no off dot again; the name in the middle switches touch off and on, so only one dot is ever lit

the Guide shows Playing the field, Dimitry's own diagram: pattern shapes the field, touch disturbs and directs it, sound vibrates it, picture and video connect it to your world, and time syncs it, with a stopwatch at the center
the field line, "The field is always there. You can shape it. You can move it. You can play it, but you can never control it.", on the cover, under the diagram and in the colophon

a Color ring: the scene's lines, second, ground and touch colors as dots (each opens its color), opposite, drift (the lines' hue turning round the wheel) and your saved colors; switch to it from any ring
the Play ring's robot wears the new face, its scenes as three rectangles

the Touch ring shows everything touch does: push, steer and magnet (the name in the middle switches touch off); sound (your finger plays); strength and reach, dragged across their dots; loop (record your steering); water (drops answer your finger)

the robot's face is its scenes, three rectangles, the tall one the scene playing: next sweeps them left to right, previous right to left; while the robot plays they light in turn on the beat, and in shuffle each keeps its own rhythm
the index puts what is free first, then one Pro section: what Pro adds, a row for each Pro feature with its padlock (Room, Performing, the performance board, Pulse, Packs, Water material and more)
Room is a row in Pro instead of a section of its own; everything in it works as before
in Paths, the two Pro paths, Material and Play together, come last
the Water path's first step points to the drawer's new Field row
